reviewBasis.method: Semantic review of actual reference/output pairs and learner-facing purpose; prior automated PASS labels are not treated as Product Owner approval.

fundamentalDecision.title: Reference Semantic QA is a mandatory pre-generation gate
fundamentalDecision.rule: The actual reference frame supplied to the image model must be semantically reviewed against the exact governed learner-visible state before generation.
hardRules: Reference approval is state-specific, not topic-level.
Use the smallest approved frame containing only the governed state.
Record KEEP, CROP/REMOVE, REQUIRED, PROHIBITED and MODEL-MUST-NOT-INFER elements.
Direction/topology/polarity/handedness must already be correct in the prepared reference; the generator must not re-derive them.
If reference and contract appear to disagree, stop and escalate.
A missing actual reference preview prevents auto-PASS.
Technical PASS does not imply pedagogical or visual PASS.
Sibling visual families must use a consistent visual grammar.
Assessment variants should vary only the governed assessed/revealed fact.
Generated labels/arrows are technical content when they carry meaning and require pixel inspection.

entries.semanticFinding: Assessment retains X stimulus and withholds circulation.
Dot stimulus and counter-clockwise field circulation are clear.

entries.requiredAction: Keep right-hand reference but require the magnetic-field arrow to follow the curl of the fingers around the conductor; remove detached little-finger-to-index-finger arrow.
entries.semanticFinding: Handedness is correct, but the field-direction cue does not visually teach curled fingers = field circulation.

entries.requiredAction: Build exact state reference: one N/S pair, one N→S magnetic-field-line system, X conductor marker, one reference-authorised force arrow. No direction re-derivation.
Same exact apparatus as teaching sibling but withhold force arrow only.
entries.semanticFinding: Assessment sibling should differ only by answer cue.

entries.requiredAction: Exact state reference: one N/S pair, one field system, dot marker, one reference-authorised force arrow.
Same apparatus as teaching sibling; withhold force arrow only.
Build separately verified vertical state reference with one field system, X marker and one force arrow.
entries.semanticFinding: Current image is not immediately interpretable.

entries.requiredAction: Use verified vertical apparatus; withhold force arrow only.
entries.semanticFinding: Assessment sibling must preserve only givens.

entries.requiredAction: Verified vertical state reference with one field system, dot marker and one force arrow; no extra Force text unless used consistently.
Use verified sibling apparatus; withhold force arrow only.
entries.semanticFinding: Assessment sibling must be visually identical apart from withheld answer.

entries.requiredAction: Use an actual visible exact reference. Preferred: FAA-derived public-domain Elementary generator.svg or explicit DOE Figure 1 crop. Prepare simplified face-on frame: ONE loop, shaft, two slip rings, two brushes, N/S, output.
entries.semanticFinding: Review says reference preview not found; generated topology is visually ambiguous and can read as two loops/coils.

entries.requiredAction: Second exact frame from the same one-loop topology, rotated to edge-on/near-peak state. Must visibly be the same one loop/shaft/two-ring system.

entries.semanticFinding: Clear Class II geometry and label defect resolved.

entries.requiredAction: Crop ONLY abstract Class-III schematic from PSF source, excluding excavator/digger, or use direct ThirdClassLever.svg. Match Class I/II family.
entries.semanticFinding: Digger cue contaminated generation into gearbox/actuator/bucket.
Field direction and topology now good.

entries.requiredAction: Clean/regenerate: no Repel word, no explanatory force label; field geometry and N/S should communicate repulsion; improve sharpness.
entries.semanticFinding: Current output is fuzzy and adds unnecessary answer-like text.

entries.requiredAction: Clean/regenerate: remove Attract and double-headed arrow; retain N/S and physically meaningful connecting field lines.
entries.semanticFinding: Field pattern should communicate attraction without baked answer words.

entries.requiredAction: Prepare controlled board using A for cross-sectional area or no area symbol. Remove inherited S. Same material/A, vary only L; avoid baked conclusion if reuse/assessment needs neutrality.
entries.semanticFinding: Source notation S conflicts with course R=ρL/A.

entries.requiredAction: Rebuild as matched sibling: same material/L, vary only A; use A/2A consistently; minimal labels.
entries.semanticFinding: Family should use one governed notation/grammar.

entries.requiredAction: Minimal verified 2D reference: one moving conductor, rails only if needed, one B convention, one v arrow, one l dimension. Forbid photoreal/3D pipe-like apparatus.
Keep physical resistor; add native/deterministic labels for 1st band, 2nd band, multiplier, tolerance when colour-code teaching is active.
entries.semanticFinding: Physical form is strong; band-role labels are pedagogically important.

entries.requiredAction: Keep physical capacitor reference but remove UK/IEC symbol from physical-recognition raster if present. Symbol remains separate deterministic card.
entries.semanticFinding: Capacitor breaks family consistency if it alone includes the symbol.

entries.requiredAction: Build exact Level-2 reference using governed diode symbol, simple DC source and conventional-current arrow. Same composition as reverse sibling.
entries.semanticFinding: Current image is hard to understand; semiconductor-band reference is the wrong composition authority.

entries.requiredAction: Use same circuit as forward sibling; reverse only source polarity/state and show blocked current clearly.
entries.semanticFinding: Forward/reverse should be a one-variable comparison.

entries.requiredAction: Prepare exact board with battery, electrodes, electrolyte, cations/anions and EVERY ion arrow already correct. Cations→cathode; anions→anode. No meters. Gemini may restyle but not add/remove/reverse arrows.
entries.semanticFinding: At least one cation-side arrow is visibly wrong despite automated PASS.

entries.requiredAction: Retire Stranded lamp wire.jpg as primary teaching reference. Build purpose-specific cable cutaway or controlled metal-vs-polymer comparison with unmistakable conductor/insulator roles.
entries.semanticFinding: Two near-identical stripped cables do not teach the conceptual comparison.
